description: This is a test source file for the OrderType class in the OpenMRS project, containing unit tests that verify the behavior of OrderType methods such as getJavaClass and addConceptClass.

classes.name: OrderTypeTest
classes.description: Test class verifying methods of the OrderType class in OpenMRS, including getJavaClass and addConceptClass functions.

methods.name: setJavaClass_shouldGetJavaClassObject
methods.description: Tests that setting the Java class name in OrderType results in getJavaClass returning the correct Class object.

methods.name: addConceptClass_shouldAddTheSpecifiedConceptClass
methods.description: Verifies that adding a ConceptClass to OrderType results in it being present in its collection.

methods.name: addConceptClass_shouldNotAddADuplicateConceptClass
methods.description: Checks that duplicate ConceptClass entries are not added multiple times to OrderType.
